naslov: Coby White returns for Hornets, Kon Knueppel 'right around the corner'
tekst:
CHARLOTTE, N.C. -- Coby White made his season debut for the Hornets in Monday night's 124-91 loss to the visiting Detroit Pistons, and shooting guard Kon Knueppel's return is "right around the corner," according to head coach Charles Lee.
Lee wouldn't give an exact date for Knueppel's return. Knueppel led the NBA in 3-pointers last season and finished as runner-up to Cooper Flagg in the NBA rookie of the year voting.
Both White (calf) and Knueppel (hamstring) were injured during offseason workouts and neither has played this season.
White became the team's starting point guard when the Hornets traded away LaMelo Ball earlier in the offseason. Dennis Schroder has been starting with White out. White finished seven points on 3-of-8 shooting in 16 minutes. Lee said before the game that White would be on a minutes restriction for the foreseeable future. 
Knueppel, who averaged 18.5 points and 5.3 rebounds last season, has been participating in 5-on-5 drills and the team has begun adding contact drills with him.
Knueppel is expected to take Sion James' spot in the starting lineup upon his return.
The Hornets next visit Brooklyn on Wednesday night and host Boston on Thursday night.
The Associated Press contributed to this report.
